purpose: Before accepting the large negative F1 refiner-level effect, prove the Phase-28 evaluation pipeline reproduces the FROZEN canonical candidate Dice exactly.
method: Recompute global Dice and candidate-refined Dice from the frozen prob512 + frozen canonical Phase25C refined crops using the canonical roi_geometry + phase25c_common.fuse_full_field + frozen 0.50 segmentation threshold, and compare to the frozen delta/gain label table columns global_dice and candidate_refined_dice.
conclusion: The Phase-28 pipeline is bit-faithful to the frozen canonical Phase25C candidate construction. The large negative F1 refiner-level effect is a GENUINE scientific result, not an evaluation artifact.
